title: Retrospective assessment of factors influencing postoperative outcomes in pancreatic surgery
summary:
Postoperative morbidity and mortality following pancreatic surgery remain high despite advancements in perioperative management. Various factors, such as preoperative weight loss or the perioperative use of medication may correlate with postoperative outcomes.

This retrospective study aims to evaluate the influence of various preoperative factors on the postoperative and oncological outcomes of patients who have undergone pancreatic surgery.  the result could be used to  achieve the best possible postoperative outcomes in personaliezed patient care.

interventions.name: Patients after pancreatic resection due to pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma from 2010 to 2021.  The observation period extends until December 2024. Pancreatoduodenectomies and distal pancreatectomies are both included
